name: cardgame-tools-fs-lock-dedup
title: Extract the two independently-reinvented cross-process file locks in tools/ into one shared, tested lib/fs-lock.js
pitch: tools/build-site.js and tools/composite-card-art.js each hand-roll their own cross-process stale-lock-reclaim logic; consolidate into one shared, directly-tested lib/fs-lock.js module.
why_now: The recent roadmap has been almost entirely growth (world races, alpha set cards, art briefs, render-engine layers, spatial cards) with no simplification pass; this is the clearest concrete dedup target in the repo. It's also not cosmetic: build-site.js's home-grown lock/rmSync path already caused a real intermittent receipt failure that the orchestrator hand-fixed on 2026-07-29 (commit 9036582), and composite-card-art.js independently reinvents the same stale-lock-reclaim pattern with a different mechanism (mkdir-based, async-poll vs openSync-based, Atomics.wait) — a second differently-shaped copy of the exact bug class that already bit once.
expected_outcome: `node --test` passes with new lib/fs-lock.js tests proving mutual exclusion and stale-lock reclaim; grepping tools/build-site.js and tools/composite-card-art.js for lock/mtimeMs/stale-detection logic returns nothing — each file shows a single `require('../lib/fs-lock')` line instead of its own reimplementation.
intent: tools/build-site.js's withBuildLock/isLockStale and tools/composite-card-art.js's withOutDirLock independently implement the same cross-process exclusive-lock-with-stale-reclaim pattern (open-or-wait, compare mtimeMs against a 30s staleness threshold, reclaim and retry) with near-duplicate rationale comments but different mechanics. Extract a single shared implementation into lib/fs-lock.js, update both tools to call it instead of declaring their own lock functions, and add a direct unit test for the shared module's mutual-exclusion and stale-reclaim behavior. This is a behavior-preserving refactor verified by passing tests, not a repo-state assertion (avoids the T11 pitfall) — every existing build-site and composite-card-art test must stay green unmodified.

criteria.text: lib/fs-lock.js exists and exports a lock function implementing exclusive acquire-or-wait plus stale-lock reclaim (lock older than a threshold is treated as abandoned and reclaimed rather than blocking forever)
tools/build-site.js contains no local withBuildLock/isLockStale function declarations and instead requires the lock helper from lib/fs-lock.js; test/build-site.test.js passes unmodified
tools/composite-card-art.js contains no local withOutDirLock function declaration and instead requires the lock helper from lib/fs-lock.js; test/composite-card-art.test.js passes unmodified

A new test/fs-lock-dedup.test.js exercises lib/fs-lock.js directly: a second concurrent acquire attempt is excluded until the first releases, and a lock left behind by a killed process (mtime older than the stale threshold) is automatically reclaimed rather than hanging
Full `node --test` run is green (pre-existing suite plus the new fs-lock tests)
